info.title: EDUNEXUS API
info.description: Section 1: staff authorization and school configuration. Bearer tokens come from Supabase Auth. All deployed access requires MFA. Business roles are read from the database; client metadata never grants privileges. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in Asia/Manila; timestamps are UTC. No learner, attendance, grade, or official-form endpoints exist yet.

get.summary: Get the active staff profile and session assurance

patch.description: Requires principal or administrative_officer. Supply the last-read version; refresh after HTTP 409.

post.summary: Authorize an existing Supabase Auth identity
post.description: Requires principal or administrative_officer. Provision the identity in Supabase Auth first. This endpoint grants school access; it does not send an invitation. Administrative officers may only authorize teachers.
